name: q-e2e
description: Turns "tests pass" into evidence: runs the Playwright specs a turn affected when Claude tries to stop, blocks on real app bugs, triages red specs with Jev (Haiku fallback) and heals drifted locators with a guarded Haiku subagent.

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe Jev API key
jevApiKey.description: Optional. Used only in the Authorization header of the triage request to api.typesafe.ai. Empty: TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment, else Haiku triage.

mode.title: Gate mode
mode.description: off: never run at stop. affected: run the specs this turn's edits affect. all: run the whole suite at stop.

maxStopSeconds.title: Max seconds at stop
maxStopSeconds.description: Time budget of the stop gate: the Playwright run, triage and one flaky retry.

runner.title: Runner
runner.description: Command that runs Playwright, split on spaces (npx, pnpm exec, bunx, yarn).

followUp.title: Follow-up when red
followUp.description: Used when the classic Stop hook cannot run (e.g. managed settings bypass it): auto submits the failures as a follow-up prompt (max 2 per prompt), suggest proposes it in the prompt box, off only notes it for the next prompt.

triage.title: Triage
triage.description: shadow: Jev/Haiku labels are logged and shown but every red spec gates as an app bug and no healer starts. on: labels decide (drift → healer, env-auth → notify, app-bug → block).

envWrapper.title: Env wrapper
envWrapper.description: Optional prefix that injects test-account secrets, split on spaces, e.g. "op run --env-file=.env.e2e --".
